title: PRICE_ASK drops the priced note for a price ask that names storage, capacity, data or RAM as the product, such as 'How much is OneDrive storage per user per month?'
goal: kbfacts.PRICE_ASK matches a 'how much is <product> per user|device|month|year' price ask whose product names storage, capacity, data or RAM (OneDrive storage, Power BI Premium capacity, Sentinel data ingestion, a Cloud PC with 8 GB RAM), as it did before BG-apytw7fo, while 'How much memory per device does Intune need?' and 'how much data per month' still get no priced note: the repro exits 0

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts as k;p=['How much is OneDrive storage per user per month?','How much is the Power BI Premium capacity per month?','How much is Microsoft Sentinel data ingestion per month?'];n=['How much memory per device does Intune need?'];bad=[q for q in p if not k.PRICE_ASK.search(q)]+[q for q in n if k.PRICE_ASK.search(q)];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
